##### Project general facts

Luluat Marina at Luluat Al Raha is a premium waterfront residential development designed around the concept of “a view for every point of view.” Located within the Marina District, the project offers a collection of studios, lofts, and 1–3 bedroom apartments, including duplex layouts, all thoughtfully positioned to capture marina, sea, and park views. The architecture emphasizes openness, natural light, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, creating a refined coastal lifestyle where every residence is connected to water, greenery, and the rhythm of marina living.

The development features a curated range of amenities designed for everyday comfort and an active lifestyle. Residents enjoy swimming pools, fully equipped fitness facilities, landscaped outdoor spaces, and a vibrant marina promenade ideal for walking and socializing. Additional conveniences include beach access, F&B outlets, concierge services, and 24/7 security, ensuring a well-balanced and secure environment where leisure, wellness, and community living come together effortlessly.

Interiors are designed with functionality and flexibility in mind, offering modern layouts that adapt to different lifestyles, from compact studios to spacious family residences. Units feature contemporary finishes, open-plan living areas, and large windows that maximize views and natural light. Kitchens are well-integrated within the living space, and homes are delivered with high-quality materials, creating a comfortable, elegant, and move-in-ready environment suited for both end-users and investors.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha Beach is one of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious waterfront destinations, located along the coastline within Abu Dhabi. The area is known for its modern urban planning, combining residential, commercial, and leisure spaces in a vibrant seaside setting. With its prime location near the main highway and key city landmarks, it offers both convenience and a relaxed coastal lifestyle.

The community features a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including marinas, private beaches, landscaped promenades, retail outlets, cafes, and dining destinations. Residents benefit from a well-developed infrastructure with schools, healthcare facilities, and recreational spaces, making it ideal for families and professionals alike. Its waterfront environment encourages outdoor living, with walking paths, cycling tracks, and open spaces overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

Al Raha Beach enjoys excellent connectivity, situated just minutes away from Zayed International Airport, Yas Island, and the city center. The area offers a balanced lifestyle that combines urban convenience with seaside tranquility, making it a highly desirable location for both residential living and real estate investment in Abu Dhabi.
